question: Quel est le délai pour retourner un article ?
expected_answer: 30 days after delivery (counted from the delivery date, not the order date).

question: Les retours sont-ils gratuits ?
expected_answer: Yes, returns are free. A prepaid return label is sent by email once the request is approved.

question: Combien de temps faut-il pour être remboursé ?
expected_answer: Within 5 to 10 business days after the parcel is received.

question: Combien coûte la livraison express ?
expected_answer: 7 euros, whatever the amount of the order (express is never free).

question: Jusqu'à quand puis-je annuler une commande ?
expected_answer: Only while the order is being prepared (status processing). Once shipped, it cannot be cancelled.

question: Peut-on échanger un article contre une autre taille ?
expected_answer: Yes: same item in another size or colour, depending on stock. An advisor handles it; the assistant passes the request as a ticket.

question: Quels articles ne peuvent pas être retournés ?
expected_answer: Underwear and swimwear, for hygiene reasons.

question: How long does standard delivery take?
expected_answer: 3 to 5 business days.

question: From what amount is standard delivery free?
expected_answer: From 50 euros of items, calculated before delivery costs.

question: In what condition must an item be to be returned?
expected_answer: Unworn, with its tags attached, and in its original packaging.

question: Which payment method is used for refunds?
expected_answer: The payment method used for the order.

question: Can I change my delivery address?
expected_answer: Only while the order is being prepared (status processing). After shipping it cannot be changed. The assistant cannot modify an order itself; it passes the request to an advisor.

question: How do I request a return?
expected_answer: Ask the assistant: it checks the item is eligible, asks for confirmation, then submits the request. An advisor then approves or refuses it.

question: Can I send back just one item from an order?
expected_answer: Yes. Each item is returned separately, and only one return request can be made per item.

question: je peux renvoyer mes baskets apres 3 semaines ?
expected_answer: Yes if it is within 30 days of delivery (3 weeks is within the delay) and the shoes are unworn, with tags and original packaging.

question: mon colis est parti mais pas encore arrivé, je peux le renvoyer direct ?
expected_answer: No. An order shipped but not yet delivered cannot be returned until it arrives; then the 30 days start.

question: c'est quoi le délai pour avoir mon argent après un retour??
expected_answer: Refund within 5 to 10 business days after the parcel is received (once the return is approved).

question: jai commandé la mauvaise taille, vous pouvez me mettre la taille au dessus ?
expected_answer: An exchange for another size is possible depending on stock. An advisor handles it; the assistant passes the request as a ticket and cannot create the exchange itself.

question: Ma commande est encore en prépa, je peux changer ladresse ?
expected_answer: Yes, while the order is being prepared (processing). The assistant cannot modify the order itself; it passes the request to an advisor as a ticket.

question: si ma commande dépasse un peu 50 euros la livraison est offerte ou pas ?
expected_answer: Yes, standard delivery is free from 50 euros of items (express is never free).

question: vous reprenez les maillots de bain ?
expected_answer: No. Swimwear cannot be returned, for hygiene reasons.

question: can i send my jumper back if i already wore it once
expected_answer: No. Items must be unworn, with tags attached and in the original packaging.

question: how fast can i get my order if im in a hurry
expected_answer: Express delivery: 1 to 2 business days, for 7 euros.

question: you received my parcel 3 weeks ago and i still havent been refunded
expected_answer: Refunds are issued within 5 to 10 business days after receipt; more than 10 business days have passed, so the assistant can pass the case to an advisor.

question: can i swap my blue shirt for the same one in black
expected_answer: Yes, the same item in another colour, depending on stock. An advisor handles it; the assistant passes the request as a ticket.

question: do i pay for sending stuff back?
expected_answer: No, returns are free. A prepaid label is sent by email once the request is approved.

question: can i still cancel my order, it says shipped
expected_answer: No. A shipped order cannot be cancelled. Once delivered, items can be returned within 30 days.

question: my order says processing, what does that mean?
expected_answer: Processing means the order is being prepared (before shipping). While processing it can still be cancelled or its address changed.

question: Ma commande vient d'être expédiée mais je veux la retourner, comment faire ?
expected_answer: A shipped order cannot be cancelled and cannot be returned before delivery. Once delivered, the items can be returned within 30 days under the return conditions.

question: Si je retourne un article, est-ce que je reçois l'étiquette avant de l'envoyer et quand serai-je remboursé ?
expected_answer: The prepaid label is sent by email once the return request is approved. The refund comes 5 to 10 business days after the parcel is received.

question: J'ai annulé ma commande hier et je n'ai toujours pas été remboursé, que faire ?
expected_answer: The assistant cannot issue refunds itself; it passes the case to an advisor as a ticket.

question: Je préfère être remboursé plutôt qu'échanger ma robe, c'est possible ?
expected_answer: Yes, a return can be requested instead of an exchange, under the return conditions and delay (30 days after delivery).

question: My order has been delivered. Can I still change the address or cancel it?
expected_answer: No, cancellation and address changes are only possible while the order is being prepared. Items can still be returned within 30 days of delivery.

question: If my return is refused, what can I do and will I still be refunded?
expected_answer: If the customer disagrees, the assistant can pass the case to an advisor for review. A refund is issued only after a return is approved and the parcel received.

question: I ordered two items totalling 45 euros with standard delivery. How much is delivery, and can I return just one of them later?
expected_answer: Standard delivery costs 4.90 euros (under 50 euros). Yes, one item can be returned on its own within 30 days of delivery.

question: I want to cancel my order and get my money back, how does it work?
expected_answer: Cancellation is only possible while the order is processing; the assistant passes the request to an advisor as a ticket, and a missing refund after a cancellation is also passed to an advisor.

question: Mon panier fait 49,90 €. Combien je paie la livraison standard ?
expected_answer: 4.90 euros, because the items total is under 50 euros.

question: J'ai commandé pour 50,00 € d'articles, la livraison standard est-elle gratuite ?
expected_answer: Yes. An order of exactly 50.00 euros in items qualifies for free standard delivery.

expected_answer: No. The return period is 30 days after delivery, and 40 days have passed.

expected_answer: 2 days left (30-day period from the delivery date).

expected_answer: 7 euros (express costs 7 euros whatever the amount).

expected_answer: 7 euros. Express delivery is never free, even above 50 euros.

question: I received my parcel 12 days ago. Can I still return a pullover I haven't worn?
expected_answer: Yes, 12 days is within the 30-day period, provided it is unworn with tags and original packaging.

question: I bought a swimsuit 5 days ago, tags on, never worn. Can I return it?
expected_answer: No. Swimwear cannot be returned for hygiene reasons, even within the delay.

question: You received my parcel 7 business days ago and the refund isn't there yet. Is it late?
expected_answer: Not yet. Refunds are issued within 5 to 10 business days after receipt. After 10 business days the assistant can pass the case to an advisor.

question: My order is currently shipped. Can you change the delivery address?
expected_answer: No. The address can only be changed while the order is being prepared (processing).

question: Avez-vous un code promo pour une première commande ?

question: Puis-je acheter une carte cadeau ?
expected_answer: Yes. Gift cards are available in amounts of 20, 50 and 100 euros, sent by email as a digital code, and valid for 12 months.

question: Avez-vous un magasin physique près de chez moi ?
expected_answer: The documents do not cover this. The assistant says it does not have this information and does not invent an answer.

question: Livrez-vous à l'étranger ?
expected_answer: No. The shop delivers only within the country where it operates; international delivery is not offered.

question: Quels moyens de paiement acceptez-vous ?
expected_answer: Bank cards (Visa and Mastercard), PayPal, and mobile wallets such as Apple Pay and Google Pay. Shop gift cards can also be used.

question: Comment dois-je laver un pull en laine ?
expected_answer: By hand in cold water with a gentle detergent, or on the wool cycle. Do not wring; press the water out and dry flat away from direct heat. The care label comes first.

question: Quelle taille dois-je choisir si je fais 1,75 m ?
expected_answer: The documents do not cover this. The assistant says it does not have this information and does not invent an answer. The size guide is based on body measurements (chest, waist, hips, foot length), not on height; the assistant must not pick a size from height alone.

question: Do you have a loyalty programme?

question: What is your customer service phone number?
expected_answer: The documents do not cover this. The assistant says it does not have this information and does not invent an answer. It may mention the chat assistant and the support email, but must not give a phone number.

expected_answer: Within 30 days after the delivery date. After 30 days, the assistant passes the case to an advisor, who decides on any follow-up.

question: je suis entre le M et le L, je prends quoi ?

question: le zip de ma veste a cassé au bout de 2 semaines, je peux la renvoyer ?
expected_answer: Yes, a defect reported within 30 days after delivery can be sent back, even if the item was worn once, as long as it is not due to misuse. An advisor decides; sending back a defective item is free.

question: can i use two promo codes on the same order
expected_answer: No. Only one promo code can be used per order.

question: i forgot my password and the email never came
expected_answer: Check the spam folder and the spelling of the email address. If it still does not arrive, tell the assistant, which creates a ticket.

expected_answer: Advisors do not join the chat live. The assistant is available at any time and can create a ticket; advisors handle tickets Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 18:00.

question: can i put my suede boots in the washer
